name: draftcheck
description: Find AI-writing patterns ("AI slop") in prose: not-X-but-Y contrasts, dramatic closers, chatbot leftovers, stock vocabulary, em-dash overuse. Deterministic linter, not an AI detector. Adds the draftcheck agent skill and the DraftCheck MCP server (slop_check and slop_patterns are free; slop_check_long needs Pro).
